column1: # TRACK-23 v5 (G4): one row per carried-P case, shared by hooks/tests/test-retro-phase5-gate-handoff.sh
# (the gate) and mods/context-handoff/tests/pure/retro-latch-v4.spec.ts (the mod). Session N has no latch
# of its own; its previous session P has active-P and no approved-P. Columns, tab-separated: case, kind
# of carried-P (none, file, dir, symlink to a file, unreadable file), its content, and the decision
# (latched: P's latch applies to N; released: P was carried to N). Content tokens: @N, @P and @X (an
# unrelated valid id) are session ids, @PAD is 120 spaces, \n \r \0 are newline, carriage return and
# NUL, and a lone - is empty.
